findings.requirement_or_question: Identify the actual IGS producer, archive and local acquisition chain

evidence_sources.precise_version_or_location: original receipt, unchanged compressed/expanded hashes; SP3 lines 1-22

directly_observed_evidence: IGS combined FIN product acquired through BKG at 2026-10-24T05:00:22.757926Z; header IGS/IGS20/GPS/HLM.
CDDIS earlier yielded HTML sign-in, not authenticated SP3 bytes.
findings.limitation: Scoped to the acquired IGS chain; this is not proof of a hash-identical unacquired NASA copy or complete upstream measurement lineage.
required_next_evidence: A producer run manifest if stronger origin/revision assurance is needed; do not relabel BKG as producer.

findings.requirement_or_question: Identify contributors recorded in the specific week-2295 evidence

findings.requirement_or_question: Identify known IGS software, forces and processing conventions without inventing a run baseline
directly_observed_evidence: Summary names historical software origins, not deployed executable releases.

ESA strategy states NAPEOS 3.9; preparation 2012-10-26, updates through 2015-06-30; visibly not a 2024 run manifest.
SP3 carries PCV:IGS20 and OL/AL:FES2014b NONE, ORB:CMB CLK:CMB.

findings.limitation: Examples cover documented paths, not all ACs or exact epoch-specific software/resources/observation dependencies.
required_next_evidence: Historical per-AC configuration/software/resource and combination-run manifests.

findings.requirement_or_question: Separate individual AC solutions from independent measurements

findings.limitation: Shared resources are a documented dependency path, not a recovered overlap list for G30 or proof of GP overlap. Multiple ACs do not establish independent samples.
required_next_evidence: Actual input observation/source inventories and shared-constraint audit; no effective independent sample count assumed.

findings.requirement_or_question: Test mathematical independence of planned SGP4 evaluation from GP generating model

planned existing SGP4 evaluation, no calculation authorization

findings.requirement_or_question: Assess different IGS dynamics versus GP model and common physical concepts

evidence_sources.precise_version_or_location: ORBIT MODELS and numerical integration lines 780-850
ORBIT MODELS and numerical integration sections

directly_observed_evidence: Published AC numerical-dynamics approaches differ from GP mean-element/SGP4 representation.
findings.limitation: Different models do not establish independent assumptions/errors; actual 2024 configurations and missing GP settings are unknown. Gravity/third-body concepts may be common without identical implementation.
required_next_evidence: Actual per-source model inventories and source dependency review; no covariance inferred from model names.

findings.requirement_or_question: Qualify common/different frame, time, EOP and reference-point dependencies
directly_observed_evidence: Reference IGS20/GPS; intended GP TEME/UTC; existing Astropy ITRS path audited, not qualified as matching IGS20.
Coverage of pinned IERS values does not establish subdaily ERP/model compatibility; actual calibration and fitted physical-point pairing remain open.
findings.limitation: Common reference basis is required for comparison; it can share systematic errors but is not proof of measurement independence or of dependence on identical observations.
required_next_evidence: Qualified realization/EOP/subdaily/time/point chain, historical resources and controls; do not apply new corrections here.

findings.requirement_or_question: Determine actual measurement-source independence of intended GP/reference pair

No evidence inventory proves shared observations or excludes GP use of related upstream ephemerides/constraints for this actual record.
findings.limitation: Neither overlap nor independence established. Different organizations/distributors alone are insufficient.
required_next_evidence: Actual GP sensor/fit/source documentation plus applicable IGS input lineage; record file alone may be insufficient.

findings.requirement_or_question: Determine support for independent accuracy validation
directly_observed_evidence: No actual GP pair, propagation, residuals or independent truth acquired/calculated.

findings.limitation: A future product disagreement cannot automatically be named pure propagation error, historical forecast accuracy, anomaly or operational safety.
required_next_evidence: Complete lineage, frame/point/quality/uncertainty/claims review, frozen manifest/protocol and explicit authorization; separate independent evidence for stronger claims.
